blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
An invoice is a simple document. It shows the price, the amount and the buyer. Every delivery has an invoice.

Every company has a tax number. The invoice has a number and a date. The total shows the full price. Tax is added to the total.

We use have with I, you, we and they. We use has with he, she and it. A good invoice is short and correct. You can do it!

items.q: What does an invoice show?
options: The price, the amount and the buyer
items.why: "It shows the price, the amount and the buyer."

items.q: What does every company have?
items.why: "Every company has a tax number."

items.q: The total on the invoice shows…
items.why: "The total shows the full price."

items.q: The text suggests that an invoice is…
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "An invoice is a simple document" e "A good invoice is short and correct" — algo fácil e útil.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this sentence:
options: A company has a tax number.
The total shows the full price.
An invoice must be long and difficult.
items.why: Inferência: o texto defende que "A good invoice is short and correct" — o autor discorda de "longa e difícil".

blocks.instruction: Ouça o colega explicando a fatura. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Can you help me read this invoice? I am new, and I want to understand it.

Look at the top. The invoice has a number. This number is 204. It also has a date. The date is May tenth. That is the delivery day.

Now look here. The company has a tax number. Every company has one. It is very important for the office.

At the bottom, we have the total. The total is the full price. First we see the amount, then we add the tax. The tax makes the total bigger.

I check the number and the date every time. A good invoice is short and correct. When the numbers are right, we save a lot of time. Thank you for your help! Now I understand the invoice, and I can read the next one alone.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the number of this invoice?
items.why: "The invoice has a number. This number is 204."

items.q: What is the date on the invoice?
items.why: "It also has a date. The date is May tenth."

items.q: What does the tax do to the total?
items.why: "The tax makes the total bigger."

items.q: The speaker suggests that he…
options: is learning and needs some help
items.why: Inferência: "I am new" e "Can you help me read this invoice?" — ele está aprendendo.

items.q: Why does the speaker check the number and the date every time?
items.why: Inferência: "When the numbers are right, we save a lot of time."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please send the invoice to the buyer today." An invoice is…
options: a document with the price and the buyer
items.why: Invoice = fatura, o documento com preço, valor e comprador.

items.q: "The tax is added to the total." Tax means…
items.why: Tax = imposto, dinheiro pago ao governo, somado ao total.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Every company has a tax ___."
items.why: "Every company has a tax number" — number = número.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ on the invoice is May tenth, the delivery day."
items.why: Date = data; combina com "May tenth", o dia da entrega.

items.q: "The total is 500 dollars." The total is…
items.why: Total = total, o preço cheio na fatura.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com faturas. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill in the invoice with the date and the number." To fill in means to…
options: write the information in the spaces
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever as informações nos espaços.

items.q: "Let's add up the numbers to find the total." To add up means to…
items.why: Add up = somar, juntar os números para achar o total.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the invoice." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "I will look up the tax number on the system." To look up means to…
items.why: Look up = procurar/consultar uma informação.

items.q: "We send out the invoice after the delivery." To send out means to…
items.why: Send out = enviar, mandar a fatura para fora.
